`nowMs` is named in milliseconds but gets `Date.now() / 1000`, which is in seconds (off by 1000x). Convert the value once where it enters (`(Date.now() / 1000) * 1000`); or, if the name is wrong, rename it to its real unit.

`timeoutMs` is named in milliseconds but gets `timeoutSeconds`, which is in seconds (off by 1000x). Convert the value once where it enters (`timeoutSeconds * 1000`); or, if the name is wrong, rename it to its real unit.

`Date` takes milliseconds for `value`, but `payload.exp` is in seconds (off by 1000x). Convert the argument once where it enters (`payload.exp * 1000`).
`retryOk` takes milliseconds for `delayMs`, but `backoffSeconds` is in seconds (off by 1000x). Convert the argument once where it enters (`backoffSeconds * 1000`).
